Each piece displays unique colors, patterns, and textures. Specimens are mostly raw and unpolished, with some showing natural crystal formations and others having porous or layered surfaces. Many pieces are labeled with identification numbers. All specimens are in raw condition, stored loose together with some flaking & chipping. Suitable for collectors, educators, or geology enthusiasts.

279862582.description:
Mixed Mineral & Artifact Collection
Various Gemstones, Minerals, and Lithic Points
Assorted Dimensions
Unsigned / Ancient
This comprehensive lapidary and mineral collection features a diverse array of natural specimens, carved decorative objects, and ancient lithic artifacts. The lot includes six significant chert or flint projectile points (arrowheads) exhibiting characteristic knapping and varied patinas. Decorative elements include polished stone eggs, carved mushrooms in rose quartz and selenite, and faceted fluorite. The collection is anchored by large rough mineral specimens, including vibrant green malachite and a substantial selenite wand.
Features a variety of gemstones including amethyst, rose quartz, tigers eye, and pyrite
Includes a selection of carved heart-shaped stone pendants with metal bails
Variety of textures ranging from raw mineral clusters to highly polished decorative eggs
Condition:
Overall good condition. Natural mineral specimens show expected raw textures, inclusions, and fractures inherent to geological formations. Lithic artifacts show age-appropriate wear and typical knapping patterns. Carved and polished items are structurally sound with minor surface abrasions consistent with handling. Warehouse Location: Cleveland
